Name.description: Deployment name as specified by the vendor.

ModelName.description: Optional vendor model name. Defaults to Name when omitted.

ClientName.description: Client name for the registered AI provider.

ConnectionName.description: Connection name used to configure the provider.

Endpoint.description: Contained-connection endpoint alias for recipe imports. Supported by AzureSpeech deployments.

AuthenticationType.description: Contained-connection authentication type alias for recipe imports. Supported by AzureSpeech deployments.

ApiKey.description: Contained-connection API key alias for recipe imports. Supported by AzureSpeech deployments.

IdentityId.description: Contained-connection managed identity client ID alias for recipe imports. Supported by AzureSpeech deployments.

Endpoint.description: Contained-connection endpoint. Used by AzureSpeech deployments.

AuthenticationType.description: Azure authentication type. Supported values are Default, ManagedIdentity, or ApiKey.

ApiKey.description: Contained-connection API key. Required when AuthenticationType is ApiKey.

IdentityId.description: Optional client ID of a user-assigned managed identity. Used when AuthenticationType is ManagedIdentity.

items.description: Technical name of a registered model feature the underlying model was trained with, for example textGeneration, toolCalling, reasoning, imageInput, audioInput, or realtime.

Features.description: Technical names of the trained model features this deployment supports. Only declared features are offered in editors and sent to the provider.

AllowedValues.description: Subset of the registered allowed values this deployment supports. Omit or leave empty to support every registered value.

DefaultValue.description: Value applied when an operator does not select one.

Minimum.description: Inclusive minimum accepted value for numeric parameters.

Maximum.description: Inclusive maximum accepted value for numeric parameters.

additionalProperties.description: Per-deployment narrowing of a registered model parameter.

Parameters.description: Supported model parameters keyed by their registered technical name (for example reasoningEffort). A parameter that is not present is not exposed by the deployment.

AIDeploymentMetadata.description: Declared model capabilities for the deployment: the trained features it supports and the configurable model parameters it exposes.

Properties.description: Contained provider connection properties stored directly on the deployment.

anyOf.description: Legacy. Declare the model's capabilities under Properties.AIDeploymentMetadata instead. A deployment that names neither is imported as a text chat deployment.

items.description: Legacy. Declare the model's capabilities under Properties.AIDeploymentMetadata instead. A deployment that names neither is imported as a text chat deployment.

anyOf.description: Legacy deployment purposes, projected onto model capabilities on import.

Deployments.description: The AI deployments to create or update.
